notes: 95% percentile cluster bootstrap; thresholds fixed; rates are fractions. Missing poses count as infinite error and fail all tolerance checks. Empty denominators and single-class AUCs are NaN; zero-division rejection scores are 0. Undefined bootstrap replicates are excluded; valid replicate counts are in JSON. JSON null means NaN; Infinity strings mean unbounded error.
